accepted_cases: legacy campus-v2.dpapi is read, copied to .before-v3 and retained after a verified campus-v3.secure write
Linux without a key fails protected session operations with SECURE_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED while public reads and the static catalog remain available
two secure processes merge independent cookies and report STATE_CONFLICT without overwriting a conflicting value
switching the account rejects both load and commit with STATE_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH and writes no new state
a simulated browser persistence failure returns sessionPersisted=false with a concrete error
crypto timeout and cancellation kill the private child and the next call starts independently; no request is replayed
cross-domain and expired browser cookies do not widen injection scope
gateway stdout contains only the sealed browser state and never a cookie value
limits: The cloud Linux host cannot run Windows DPAPI/ACL; Windows behavior must be proven by the GitHub windows-2025 runner.
A full directory rollback that replaces both state and pointer is outside the revision/record-id guarantee.
action_store and todos retain their outer THU-ACTION-1 / THU-TODOS-1 container magic; full record identity and business migration belong to 4.4 and 5.4.
learn_assistant/providers/web.py still prints a Windows DPAPI message; the actual provider is secure-store when configured. Documentation is handed to 6.1/7.3.
The Linux key file must be created explicitly by the user; this module does not generate or export a key.
No real campus login, write, payment or submission was performed.
rollback: Stop new session writes, keep campus-v3.secure, session.secure, .before-v3 and campus-v2.dpapi, and switch to the compatibility wrapper. Do not roll back a runtime that cannot read a pending new-format transaction; require explicit re-authentication instead of deleting state.
next: Batch integration must reconnect 3.1 with the accepted 3.2 and 3.3 commits, run the batch check and full offline suite, and record Ubuntu/Windows CI. The batch gate remains ready until that integration commit is recorded.
cross_module_requests: error-classification.json owner (1.1): register SECURE_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED, SECURE_LEGACY_UNAVAILABLE, SECURE_KEY_LOCATION and related storage codes before the facade exposes them as classified errors.
learn_assistant/providers/web.py (6.1/7.3): replace the hard-coded Windows DPAPI message with SecureSessionStore.protection.
4.4: give action_store records a stable record_id and migrate the outer THU-ACTION-1 container; the compatibility wrapper already routes captured protect/unprotect references to the secure provider.
5.4: give the todo cache a stable record_id and migrate the outer THU-TODOS-1 container.
6.3: provide the default key-file setup command and packaging for crypto_service.py / crypto-bridge.js; the module does not create a key automatically.
